culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Kamakura City's public manners ordinance (in force April 2019) names nuisance behaviours it asks visitors to avoid: eating or drinking while walking in narrow or crowded places where you could soil someone's clothes; stopping in the roadway to take photos; photographing near railway tracks or other dangerous spots; leaving hiking paths; cutting or picking plants; using fire near grass on paths; running past walkers, or riding bikes and motorbikes, on narrow or crowded paths. It is a manners ordinance with no penalties, and it doesn't ban eating while walking.
culture-and-protocol.note: Kamakura only, from the city's ordinance page.

laws.rule: Kanagawa Youth Protection and Development Ordinance (神奈川県青少年保護育成条例), art. 24. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian may not let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period except for special reasons. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: 神奈川県青少年保護育成条例 (Kanagawa), curfew for young people

laws.rule: Kanagawa's 神奈川県迷惑行為防止条例 (Kanagawa Nuisance Acts Prevention Ordinance), art. 9, bans pushy touting and soliciting (客引き, 誘引) and loitering to wait for customers (客待ち) in entertainment districts. Since 1 May 2025 it covers touting for sexual services regardless of the sex of either person, and street touting for izakaya and karaoke shops (no penalty for that last group). Police can order a person to stop; the prefectural public safety commission can order businesses to suspend operations. A further amendment takes effect on 1 September 2026 on location-tracking tags used without consent. Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
laws.heading: 神奈川県迷惑行為防止条例 art. 9 (touting), amended 1 May 2025

laws.rule: Yokohama City’s parks bureau says smoking has been banned in city parks since April 2025. Its notice separately asks people not to smoke while walking.
laws.heading: No Smoking in Parks
